notes: Removes test-only restrictions from the playback wrapper; the native engine is unchanged. Preserves source dimensions and sample aspect ratio without fitting processing to a monitor or window. Normalizes decoded formats and RGB color metadata before VapourSynth, including odd coded dimensions. Defaults to 8-bit synthesis with 8/10/16/source selection, GPU/CPU and device controls, native Super/Analyse/SmoothFps JSON overrides, and automatic or configurable buffering. Restores ordinary mpv user configuration, scripts and filters; URLs/protocols are forwarded unchanged to external mpv without adding network code. Removes fixed source/target FPS, playback-duration and blanket 2x test limits while preserving actual engine constraints. Includes headless native-frame, conversion, configuration and extracted-package regression checks. ARM64 plugins are built and tested in CI, ad-hoc signed and not notarized. External mpv, Python and VapourSynth are required.
